verdict.rationale: Runloop has no built-in natural-language console of its own. A probe does confirm an official MCP server on its AI-tools page, which would let an AI assistant drive Runloop from natural-language requests, but the evidence describes nothing about what that server exposes. Cursor rules and llms.txt only help an LLM write SDK code, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of the MCP server's tools and coverage, and hands-on corroboration of operating Runloop through natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Add context about the Runloop API to your LLMs
